title: 第4章 系统任务第5章 天人十重境
content_zh:
第004章 系统任务
长亭，自古以来就是人们饯别之地，离别总令人黯然神伤，这使得“长亭”这两个字的本身就仿佛带着凄凉萧索之意。
天是晴天，阳光耀眼，却是将唐母脸上的不舍照的更加清楚。
“娘，送到这里就行了，你快回去吧。孩儿已经长大了，懂得照顾自己的。”唐安背着小包裹，内衬里穿着的是母亲给他的“金丝保甲”，天很热，金丝保甲凉丝丝的，身子很舒服，心却惆怅。
他的眼睛红红的，也曾流过泪。感觉着唐母的惜别之意浓浓，唐安别过脸去，狠狠擤了一下鼻涕，然后往自己的袖口上一抹，挺起胸膛，仰着小脸，朗声道：“娘，孩儿长大了，要去闯荡江湖了，您该高兴才是。有谁家的孩子六岁开始就能闯荡江湖的？您该为孩儿自豪！孩儿答应您，总有一天，孩儿会骑着五花马，身披千金裘，腰缠十万贯，仆从如云，带着媳妇来扬州看您的！”
唐母听到小唐安的大话，心中流过一丝暖意，脸上勉强挤出一丝笑容，不过却又忍不住强调道：“是扬州临安郡，莫要忘记了。娘等着你回来……”
唐安狠狠地点头，泪已满眶，只在眼里打转。
他狠心的背过身去，小身子倔强，而又坚定执着。他咬着牙，硬是不让眼泪流下来，踏着坚实的脚步，一步步往停靠在长亭外的马车走去。
唐母心中忽然又舍不得了，想往前跑过去，将儿子拉回来，只是唐父在旁边拦住了。
“雏鹰，总有一天要离开母巢展翅高飞的。”
唐母点点头，只好倚着栏杆，默默的看着儿子远行，她看着看着，忽然大喊道：“安儿，娘等着你……莫要忘记了……”
听到这，唐安眼眶里的泪水再也忍不住了，顿时如雨一般的落下来。
“娘，你放心吧。孩儿不会忘记的。扬州临安郡。给儿子十年时间，十年！儿子一定会回来的！”
马车晃晃悠悠的，一路向西行进……
时天下九州，中州城位于东四州中的徐州地界，而蜀山则位于荆州和扬州的交接处。不过蜀山遥遥万余里，如同天然的屏障，横亘在荆州和扬州之间。若要入蜀，从扬州却是不能过。只能绕道，穿过兖州，豫州进荆州，顺江而下，才能入蜀。
当时天下，江湖豪杰，群雄并起，朝廷势弱，又有世家门阀牵制，势力只能困锁在东四州。而扬州地界，近来又有邪教作乱，朝廷无能力平叛，只能缩小地域，巩固势力。最后只牢牢困守在冀州，青州，徐州，这天下最富裕的三大州。
至于其余六州，势力错综复杂，又有高门大派与当地势力纠葛，外来之人根本不能插手。
而蜀山位于荆州和扬州之间，正是当今天下九大门派之一。
现下已经是八月末了，小唐安在路上摇摇晃晃已经过了差不多一个月了，眼看就要到了蜀山。
唐安心中也有些激动，到了蜀山，拜入山门，从此，便成了江湖中的一份子。江湖，在那一世，可是个传说啊。江湖很精彩，江湖很残酷。只有练好功夫，他日才有衣锦还乡的可能！

这些天，唐安闲来无事，更是将老爹给自己的那本个人心得总结前前后后看了好几遍。老爹没在里面留什么武功秘籍。至于那些话，总结起来就一个意思。
一个人的天赋强弱，武功高低，并不能决定他的未来。一个成功者，只是在不断的人生挑战中做出最正确的选择。做还是不做，这是一个问题。看来很简单，可是却很多人都会选错。选错了，命也丢了，当然就再也没有机会重来了。
马车咕噜噜的响着，盘旋在一条山坳中。就在这时，外面忽然响起了“劈哩啪啦”的打斗声。
唐安听到这里，忍不住掀起帷幔，伸出脑袋去，想一看究竟，却是被车夫直接将脑袋按了回来。不过就这一瞥，唐安就看到有4男2女正在追杀一黑衣男子。那男子衣衫狼狈，不知道受了多少剑伤，身上黑衣早已破破烂烂，露出的内衬都是血色。对方六人有守有攻，配合默契。他此时已经被逼得走投无路，只能勉强护住自己要害。他的身上流血不止，过了一阵，力气枯竭，自然就被对方所擒。
车夫将唐安的脑袋按了回去，马车也停靠在了一边。车夫是个大汉，魁梧雄壮，板着一张脸，一路上来，唐安也没有跟他多说几句话。车夫叫谢晋，唐安听老爸叫他老谢，似乎是舅舅身边的得力手下。这次是派来护送自己前往蜀山学艺的。不过唐安却不知道，他还有另一个任务，那就是防止自己逃跑。
“谢叔，外面怎么了？”虽然脑袋被按了回来，可是唐安心中却是好奇心大增。难道是遇到江湖仇杀了？走江湖，遇到最多的事情就是一人在喝酒吃饭，突然杀出一个人，说还我xxx的命来。再喊一句，你这狗贼，我不杀你，誓不为人之类的。
谢晋只是将帽檐压低了，将脑袋往后凑近帷幔，对唐安道：“是蜀山七绝峰的人。你不要吵嚷，我们只是过路，不要惹不必要的麻烦。你在车里坐一会儿，他们很快就会结束的。”
“蜀山七绝峰？”唐安默默地将这个名字记在心里。很有可能自己在未来的不久，就会和这些人打上交道。只是不知道到时候又会是个什么情景。
过了一会儿，果真是听不到声响了，原来那男子已经力竭而亡。蜀山门人随后就上前割下了那人脑袋。他们把他的脑袋进一个洒了石灰的盒子里，却是留下那人的尸体在野外。怕是不多久，这尸体就会被野狗叼了去。
见前方道路已经干净，谢晋一扬马鞭，喊了一声“走”。只是当马车路过那人尸体的时候，谢晋的眉头顿时皱了起来，这人手上的伤疤，似乎在哪里见过。
见外面不吵了，唐安就掀开了马车上的窗户帘子。毕竟现在的天气还算炎热，他的身体本来就不好，长久的闷在马车里，脑袋眩晕的很。可是他一掀开帘子，只看到一副无头尸体，脖子上居然还在汩汩冒着热血。他忍不住胃部一阵蠕动，当场吐得稀里哗的了，猛的就钻出了马车，坐到了前边的车沿上。
他对江湖便又多了一点认识。乱世之中，人命如草芥！若是这男人本事比那几人高，死的就不会是他，而是对方6个人。
唐安不知道他们两方谁对谁错，他只知道那男人死了，他的脑袋被人割走了。或许是拿去领功劳了，或许是随手丢了。
江湖，这就是个弱肉强食的世界！
过了一会儿，心情平复下来了，唐安便问谢晋：“谢叔，蜀山七绝峰是什么？”
谢晋笑了一下，答道：“蜀山七绝峰，乃是蜀山之上的七大分脉，每一峰有一位首座主持。蜀山乃是天下剑派之首，有七绝峰，自然有七绝剑。而这七绝剑，便是蜀山七绝峰上的七位首座。分别是【追风】【春木】【烈火】【玄土】【赤金】【流水】【奔雷】这当世七大名剑。”谢晋说完，却是又补充道：“不过在我看来，这七大名剑只是他们蜀山自己给自己撑面子。七大首座，除了掌门【追风剑】李乘风成名已久，其他六人不过新进的江湖一流，配不上这些个名号。这些名号也只是老一辈留下的噱头而已。不过蜀山剑派，毕竟是江湖大派，派中高手如云，那是错不了的。不然，如何敢称天下第一剑派！”
谢晋说完，回过头来见唐安一脸沉思，不由笑道：“怎么？你是在想拜入蜀山哪一脉座下吗？”见唐安点头，谢晋顿时嗤笑一声：“别想了。你的路还远着呢。蜀山分为内外两堂，只有过了外堂的测试，符合要求的才能进内堂拜师。你现在想这些可有些早了。依我看，你的资质太平庸了，怕是连外堂的第一次大考都过不去。不如我在清河镇外等你三月。三月后，也免得你灰溜溜的一人回家。可好？哈哈……乐堂主有你这样的外甥，说起来还真是丢人啊。若是让江湖上的人知道了玉手唐天鏡的儿子就你这样的资质，说不定会笑掉大牙。”谢晋说着，眼神里毫不掩饰的流露出自己的轻蔑和不屑。
“我谢晋，在江湖上也是一号人物，居然被派来送你这样的小子来拜师，传出去，我谢晋的颜面何在？”谢晋说完，看向唐安的眼神更加不喜。
唐安的拳头捏的紧紧的，小脸涨得通红，心中只有一股怒火在不停的烧着，随时会爆炸。可是他却死死地忍住了，没有反驳谢晋的话。
因为谢晋说的没错，唐安的资质确实很差，他自己也知道。他天生体弱，力气较一般儿童都不如，如何与那些从小就开始煅炼身体的江湖子弟比较？他好恨，为什么当初自己选择系统属性的时候，没有选择力量或者体质，偏偏选择了敏捷。

一力降十惠！我早该想到的！
“清河镇到了！小子，自己去报名吧。三月后被刷下来可别哭鼻子。老子还有其他事情要忙，可没有空陪着你在这里耗时间。如果被刷下来，清河镇外有一条河，自己看着办吧。”说着，谢晋真的将包裹从马车上扔下来，然后打转着马车，又朝原路返回了，就连多看一眼都嫌厌恶。
整个小道上只留下唐安一人孤单单的站在原地。唐安弯下腰捡起了自己的包裹，轻轻拍去上面的尘土，里面还有唐母给他纳的一双功夫鞋。
他捏着拳头，倔强的身子挺立在小道上，就看着谢晋打着马儿离开。“我自己选的路，就算爬，我也会走完！谢晋，十年后，我要你把今天说的这些话，全都吃进肚子里！”
唐安弯下腰捡起一枚石子，狠狠地朝山边扔去，仿佛想把自己心中的怒火也全部发泄出去。
可就在这时，唐安的脑中忽然想起了一个古怪的声音。
【叮~，正式启动！】
【任务，通过蜀山外门测试，时间三个月。奖励：小培元丹一颗。失败惩罚：失去所有，包括生命。此任务不能拒绝！】
简介想改，改不掉。我晕
content_en:
Chapter 004 System Tasks
Changting has been a place for people to say goodbye since ancient times. Parting always makes people sad, which makes the word "Changting" itself seem to have a desolate meaning.
It was a sunny day and the sun was dazzling, but it illuminated the reluctance on Tang's mother's face even more clearly.
"Mom, just send it here. You can go back quickly. The child has grown up and knows how to take care of himself." Tang An was carrying a small package, and the inner lining was the "gold silk armor" given to him by his mother. The day was very hot, and the gold silk armor was cool. His body was very comfortable, but his heart was melancholy.
His eyes were red and he had shed tears. Feeling Tang's mother's deep farewell, Tang An turned away, blew his nose hard, then wiped it on his sleeves, straightened his chest, raised his little face, and said loudly: "Mom, my child has grown up and is going to travel in the world. You should be happy. Yes. Whose child can make a career at the age of six? You should be proud of your child! One day, my child will ride on a five-flowered horse, wear a golden fur, have a hundred thousand coins, and have a lot of servants, and come to Yangzhou with his wife! "
When Mother Tang heard Xiao Tang An's big words, a warmth flowed through her heart. She forced a smile on her face, but she couldn't help but emphasized: "It's Lin'an County, Yangzhou. Don't forget it. Mom is waiting for you to come back..."
Tang An nodded fiercely, tears welling up in his eyes.
He turned his back cruelly, his small body stubborn, yet firm and persistent. He gritted his teeth and tried not to let the tears flow down. He walked step by step towards the carriage parked outside the pavilion with solid steps.
Tang's mother suddenly couldn't bear it anymore and wanted to run forward and pull her son back, but Tang's father stopped him.
"The young eagle will leave its mother's nest one day and fly high."
Tang's mother nodded and had no choice but to lean on the railing and silently watch her son walking away. She watched and suddenly shouted: "An'er, mother is waiting for you...Don't forget..."
Hearing this, the tears in Tang An's eyes could no longer be held back, and they suddenly fell like rain.
"Mom, don't worry. The child will never forget it. Lin'an County, Yangzhou. Give your son ten years, ten years! My son will definitely come back!"
The carriage swayed and headed west...
At that time, there were nine states in the world. Zhongzhou City was located on the boundary of Xuzhou among the four eastern states, while Shushan was located at the junction of Jingzhou and Yangzhou. However, Shu Mountain is more than ten thousand miles away, like a natural barrier, lying between Jingzhou and Yangzhou. If you want to enter Shu, you can't cross from Yangzhou. We can only enter Shu by taking a detour, passing through Yanzhou, Yuzhou, entering Jingzhou, and going down the river.
At that time, the world was full of heroes and heroes, the imperial court was weak, and there were aristocratic families to restrain it, so its power could only be locked in the four eastern states. As for Yangzhou, a cult has recently caused rebellion. The imperial court is unable to quell the rebellion, so it can only reduce the area and consolidate its power. In the end, they were only firmly trapped in Jizhou, Qingzhou, and Xuzhou, the three richest states in the world.
As for the remaining six states, the forces are complex and there are high-ranking sects entangled with local forces, so outsiders cannot interfere at all.
Shushan, located between Jingzhou and Yangzhou, is one of the nine major sects in the world today.
It is now the end of August. Little Tang An has been staggering on the road for almost a month, and he is about to arrive at Shushan.
Tang An was also a little excited. When he arrived at Shushan, he worshiped at the mountain gate and became a part of the world from then on. Jianghu, in that life, was a legend. The arena is exciting, but the arena is cruel. Only by practicing Kung Fu well will you be able to return home in glory one day!
These days, Tang An has nothing to do, and even read the summary of personal experiences his father gave him several times. Dad didn't leave any martial arts secrets in it. As for those words, they all mean the same thing.
A person's talent and martial arts skills cannot determine his future. a successful person, just make the most correct choice in the constant challenges of life. To do or not to do, that is the question. It seems very simple, but many people make the wrong choice. If you make the wrong choice, your life is lost, and of course you will never have the chance to do it again.
The carriage made a grunting sound and circled in a mountain col. At this moment, the sound of fighting suddenly sounded outside.
When Tang An heard this, he couldn't help but lift the curtain and stretched out his head to see what was going on, but the coachman pushed his head back directly. But with just one glance, Tang An saw four men and two women chasing a man in black. The man's clothes were in a mess, and he had suffered numerous sword wounds. His black clothes were in tatters, and the exposed inner lining was full of blood. The six opponents were both defensive and offensive, and they cooperated tacitly. He was now cornered and could only barely protect his vitals. He was bleeding profusely. After a while, his strength was exhausted and he was naturally captured by the opponent.
The coachman pushed Tang An's head back, and the carriage stopped aside. The coachman was a big man, burly and majestic, with a stern face. Tang An didn't say a few words to him along the way. The coachman's name was Xie Jin, and Tang An heard his father call him Lao Xie. He seemed to be his uncle's right-hand man. This time he was sent to escort him to Shushan to study art. But Tang An didn't know that he had another mission, which was to prevent himself from escaping.
"Uncle Xie, what's going on outside?" Although his head was pressed back, Tang An's curiosity increased greatly. Could it be that he encountered a vendetta? When traveling around the world, the most common thing I encounter is when a person is drinking and eating alone, and suddenly a person comes out and offers to give me my xxx life. Shout again, you thief, I won’t kill you, I swear you won’t be a human being or anything like that.
Xie Jin just lowered the brim of his hat, leaned his head back towards the curtain, and said to Tang An: "They are from Qijue Peak in Shushan Mountain. Don't make any noise, we are just passing by, don't cause unnecessary trouble. Just sit in the car for a while, they will be over soon."
"Shu Mountain Seven Peaks?" Tang An silently remembered this name in his heart. It is very likely that I will deal with these people in the near future. I just don’t know what the situation will be like then.
After a while, there was really no sound. It turned out that the man had died of exhaustion. The Shushan disciples then stepped forward and cut off the man's head. They put his head in a box sprinkled with lime, but left the man's body in the wild. I'm afraid it won't be long before the body is picked up by wild dogs.
Seeing that the road ahead was clear, Xie Jin raised his whip and shouted "Let's go". But when the carriage passed by the man's body, Xie Jin's brows suddenly frowned. The scars on the man's hands seemed to have been seen somewhere.
Seeing that there was no noise outside, Tang An opened the window curtain on the carriage. After all, the weather is quite hot now, and his health is not good to begin with. He has been stuck in the carriage for a long time, and his head is very dizzy. But when he opened the curtain, he only saw a headless corpse, with blood still pouring from his neck. He couldn't help his stomach squirming, and he vomited on the spot. He quickly got out of the carriage and sat on the edge of the carriage in front.
He knew a little more about Jianghu. In troubled times, human life is like a piece of grass! If this man was more capable than those people, it would not be him who would die, but the other six people.
Tang An didn't know who was right or wrong. He only knew that the man was dead and his head was cut off. Maybe it was taken to claim credit, or maybe it was thrown away.
Jianghu, this is a world of the weak and the strong!
After a while, his mood calmed down, and Tang An asked Xie Jin: "Uncle Xie, what are the Seven Peaks of Shu Mountain?"
Xie Jin smiled and replied: "The Qi Jue Peaks of Shu Mountain are the seven major branches on Shu Mountain. Each peak has a chief leader. Shu Mountain is the leader of the sword sect in the world. There are Seven Jue Peaks, and naturally there are Seven Jue Swords."And this Qijue Sword is the top seven on the Qijue Peak of Shushan Mountain. They are [Chasing the Wind], [Spring Wood], [Fire], [Xuantu], [Red Gold], [Flowing Water] and [Thunder], which are the seven most famous swords in the world. "After Xie Jin finished speaking, he added: "But in my opinion, these seven famous swords are just for Shushan to support themselves. Among the top seven, except for the leader [Wind Chasing Sword] Li Chengfeng, who has been famous for a long time, the other six are just newcomers to the top ranks of the world and are not worthy of these titles. These names are just gimmicks left by the older generation. However, the Shushan Sword Sect is, after all, a major sect in the world, and there are so many masters in the sect, so there is no mistaking that. Otherwise, how could we dare to call ourselves the number one sword sect in the world! "
After Xie Jin finished speaking, he turned around and saw Tang An looking thoughtful, and couldn't help but smile: "What? Are you thinking about which lineage of Shushan you want to join? Seeing Tang An nod, Xie Jin immediately sneered: "Don't think about it." You still have a long way to go. Shushan is divided into two parts: inner and outer halls. Only those who have passed the test of the outer hall and meet the requirements can enter the inner hall to become a disciple. It's a little early for you to think about this now. In my opinion, your qualifications are so mediocre that you might not even be able to pass the first major exam in the outer hall. Why don't I wait for you outside Qinghe Town in March? After three months, I won’t let you go home alone in despair. How's that? Haha... It's really embarrassing for Hall Master Le to have a nephew like you. If people in the world knew that Yushou Tang Tianjing's son had your qualifications, they might laugh out loud. Xie Jin said, his eyes unabashedly showing his contempt and disdain.
"I, Xie Jin, am also the number one person in the world, and I was actually sent to send a boy like you to become my disciple. If word spreads, where is my reputation, Xie Jin? "After Xie Jin finished speaking, he looked at Tang An with even more unhappy eyes.
Tang An's fists were clenched tightly, his face turned red, and there was only a burning anger in his heart that was about to explode at any time. But he held it back and did not refute Xie Jin's words.
Because Xie Jin was right, Tang An's qualifications were indeed very poor, and he knew it himself. He was born weak and his strength was not as strong as that of ordinary children. How could he compare with those children from the martial arts world who had been training their bodies since childhood? He really hated why when he chose the system attribute, he didn't choose strength or constitution, but chose agility.
One effort and ten benefits! I should have thought of it earlier!
"Qinghe Town has arrived! Go ahead and sign up for yourself, kid. Don’t cry if you are dismissed after three months. I have other things to be busy with, and I don’t have time to spend time here with you. If it is brushed down, there is a river outside Qinghe Town, so you can decide what to do. "As he said that, Xie Jin really threw the package off the carriage, then spun the carriage around and returned to the original road. He was disgusted by even looking at it for a second time.
Tang An was the only one left standing alone on the entire trail. Tang An bent down and picked up his package, patting the dust off gently. There was also a pair of kung fu shoes given to him by Tang's mother.
